lyrics.text: Walk with me through a falling Kingdom

Walk with me, walk with me
You and I, you and I are gonna rule the world

You and I, you and I are gonna rule the world
You and I, you and I are gonna rule this twisted broken world
Let it fall, thy will be done
Let it fall like the midnight sun
Truth be told we stand alone
To wear a crown of dust and bone
Let it fall, let it fall
You and I, you and I are gonna rule the world
You and I, you and I are gonna rule this twisted broken world
You and I! This twisted broken world!
This twisted broken world!
You and I, you and I are gonna rule the world
You and I, you and I are gonna rule this twisted broken world
You and I! This twisted broken world!
This twisted broken world!
